verdict.rationale: The official first-project tutorial walks developers through exactly this story: creating a project and an index, adding documents, and running a first search in the web interface. A no-credit-card trial, a one-line cURL install of a dependency-free single binary, and official Docker images keep setup friction low. Community reports back this up: one user saw zero-config indexing and search within 30 minutes, and another said a one-click Docker install 'just worked'. Missing for 10: a documented time-to-first-search for the quickstart itself (the 'minutes' claim appears only in site-search marketing), and one user found that programmatic index creation and settings work in a real integration took far longer.
